text: Which statement best describes the Strategy pattern?
options: It selects an algorithm through a common interface.
It gives one object global access to every subsystem.
It stores every command as plain text.
model_answer: Option 1. Strategy encapsulates interchangeable algorithms behind a common interface.

text: Identify one reason to review code before changing it.
model_answer: Review establishes the existing contract and dependencies, reducing the chance that a locally reasonable change causes a regression elsewhere.

text: True or false: duplicated validation logic is easy to change safely.
model_answer: False. Duplicated validation can drift because every copy must be found and updated consistently.

text: Read the code and identify the branch that handles malformed JSON input.
model_answer: The except json.JSONDecodeError branch handles malformed JSON and returns the error record before candidate construction runs.

text: Name a risk of swallowing exceptions during import.
model_answer: A missing, unreadable, or malformed file can appear to be a valid empty question bank, hiding the real failure.

text: Explain why tests should have strong assertions.
model_answer: A strong assertion fixes the required outcome independently of the implementation.
